name: tevi_cell_right_wall
reproduces: adapters/tevi/MEASURED.md, "Teleport, restore and the cell's right wall" (2026-09-17): from x 16912 in the Bandit Base cell, 60 frames of XAxis+ carried the player to x 17066 and stopped there, 14 short of the wall's inner edge at 17080, and 60 more moved it nothing
needs: TEVI (the Steam build, the Randomizer disabled) with autoplay's driver loaded, in play in the Bandit Base cell where a new game's Chapter 0 opens (area BASE, room 12,11), the dev cheats off
note: The situation is made with a teleport, onto the cell's floor four tiles right of where Chapter 0 starts; the wall stopping the player is the game's own collision, met by ordinary held input. Nothing here writes a save.

held right again, against the wall: still no further
